title: The alternatives doc compares multi-agent coordination, task tracking and agent runtime tools, and says where the kb plugs into each
goal: kb/_self/alternatives.md has a section on tools that coordinate parallel agents, track their tasks or host their sessions, each with what it overlaps with, how it differs, its licence (a rider that bars some parties named as such) and the adapter or contract through which the kb complements it; its sources are cited as the doc's others are, and selfdoc.py check passes.

run:
import re,sys
t=open('kb/_self/alternatives.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines()
h=[i for i,l in enumerate(t) if l.startswith('### ') and re.search('coordinat',l,re.I)]
if not h:
    print('no ### section on coordination tools');sys.exit(1)
end=next((i for i in range(h[0]+1,len(t)) if t[i].startswith('#')),len(t))
tab=[l for l in t[h[0]:end] if l.startswith('|')]
head=[c.strip().lower() for c in tab[0].strip('|').split('|')] if tab else []
need=[any('tool' in c for c in head),any('licen' in c for c in head),any('overlap' in c for c in head),any('differ' in c for c in head),any(re.search('adapter|contract|plug|complement',c) for c in head)]
rows=[[c.strip() for c in l.strip('|').split('|')] for l in tab[2:]]
src=t[next((i for i,l in enumerate(t) if l.startswith('## Sources')),len(t)):]
srct=' '.join(src).lower()
cited=[r[0] for r in rows if r and (re.search(r'`[^`]*\.[a-z]{2,}/[^`]*`',' '.join(r)) or (re.findall(r'[a-z]{3,}',r[0].lower())[:1] and re.findall(r'[a-z]{3,}',r[0].lower())[0] in srct))]
print('columns',head,'needed',need,'rows',len(rows),'cited',len(cited))
sys.exit(0 if all(need) and len(rows)>=3 and len(cited)==len(rows) else 1)

import re,subprocess as s,sys
t=open('kb/_self/alternatives.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines()
h=[i+1 for i,l in enumerate(t) if l.startswith('### ') and re.search('coordinat',l,re.I)]
end=next((i+1 for i in range(h[0],len(t)) if t[i].startswith('#')),len(t)+1) if h else 0
p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','which tools coordinate parallel agents, track their tasks or host their sessions, and where does the kb plug into each'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
lines=[int(n) for n in re.findall(r'kb/_self/alternatives\.md:(\d+)',p.stdout)]
inside=[n for n in lines if h and h[0]<=n<end]
print('section lines',h[:1],end,'cited lines',lines[:8]);sys.exit(0 if inside else 1)
